boards.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Prism roadmap board 20, configurable task boards. Produce a high fidelity product design board with one large desktop application view and one narrow phone view, landscape, fictional project data. Refined minimalist Notion-like design: white main surface, warm gray narrow sidebar, crisp dark gray sans-serif, subtle dividers, restrained blue selection accent, tiny functional icons, generous breathing room. No marketing headline or poster slogans. Desktop app header 'Prism', Personal vault selector, sidebar Search / Messages / Favorites / Pages / Tools, New page. Main header 'Launch plan' with small breadcrumb Projects / Prism, readable quiet description. View tabs 'Board' and 'List'; toolbar 'Search tasks', 'Filter', 'View settings', 'New task'. Three clean board columns 'To do', 'In progress', 'Done' with small count badges and Add task controls, 2–3 cards per column. Fictional cards: 'Review workspace navigation', 'Polish conversation layout', 'Test keyboard flows', 'Write release notes'. Cards display actual title plus restrained priority and due-date metadata; no meaningless analytics or decorative avatars. A clear accessible card menu offers 'Open task', 'Move to…', 'Move earlier', 'Move later'. Show a subtle blue drop insertion line as an ordering affordance in one column. A small view-settings overlay illustrates existing configuration: 'Source tags' with project and task chips, 'Group by' Status, 'Sort' Manual order, 'Visible fields' Priority/Due date, 'Save view'. Explicit small helper 'Order belongs to this view'. Phone view uses a readable task LIST with the same title and filters, status groups and generous touch targets, rather than a tiny compressed kanban. Include unobtrusive footer 'Concept · fictional workspace'. Respect honest data/authority: no send/invite action, no invented AI task extraction or claims of completed verification. Prism logo should show colored beams entering a triangle from the left and one dark ray exiting right. Raster logo is illustrative; implementation will use existing vector master.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Prism expanded roadmap board 21, People directory and canonical person profile. High fidelity flat application design, large desktop and 390px phone view side by side on a neutral background; no device hardware, no slogans. Minimalist Notion-like white/soft gray interface, charcoal clean sans-serif, small blue accents, thin dividers, restrained initial avatars. Product brand Prism, existing small prism placeholder. Desktop: narrow standard workspace sidebar with Personal vault, Search, Messages, Favorites, Pages, Tools, New page. Main area split directory and selected profile. Directory heading 'People', search 'Find a person', rows Morgan Lee, Alex Rivera, Sam Chen with initials and small roles. Selected profile has large 'Morgan Lee', role 'Research partner', compact email identity 'morgan@example.test' and Telegram identity '@morgan_research' in a Properties disclosure, plus Open person note. Clearly label 'Linked identities'; no inferred verified badge. Profile content tabs 'Conversations', 'Meetings', 'Tasks'. Selected Conversations shows elegant list of 'Project discussion' with Telegram source, 'Research follow-up' with Email source, date and short fictional excerpt. Secondary section 'Related meetings' links 'Research review · Oct 2' with 'Transcript available'. Bottom of directory a quiet inline state says 'Unknown participants remain unlinked' with 'Review identities' shown as unavailable with helper 'Requires identity review service', illustrating an honest unsupported state rather than a working button. Small phone view is a full-width profile: initials/name at top, back to People, linked identities collapsed, clean tabbed related conversations, roomy touch rows and no raw filesystem paths required. Include lower corner 'Concept · fictional data'. Do not invent merged identities, auto-matching, contact syncing, sending messages, or permissions. This board is for browsing canonical person notes and existing related-record APIs; present ambiguous identity as explicit uncertainty, never matching by display name.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Prism expanded roadmap board 22, calendar and transcript review. High-fidelity flat software interface mockup, not a photo, wide board showing desktop workspace plus readable narrow phone event view. Minimal professional Notion-inspired appearance: white surfaces, warm gray workspace sidebar, charcoal sans-serif, fine borders, restrained blue accents, generous spacing. Brand Prism with small illustrative prism mark; Personal vault, Search, Messages, Favorites, Pages, Tools, New page in left sidebar. Desktop main header 'Calendar', October 2026, Today and Month / Week / Agenda controls. Calm week calendar with fictional meetings, selected 'Research review' on Friday October 2 at 10:00. Right detail panel titled 'Research review', time 10:00–11:00, attendees Morgan Lee and Alex Rivera shown as canonical person links. Sections 'Conversation records', 'Notes', 'Decisions & tasks'. Conversation records shows attached 'Research review · Recording 1' with Transcript / Open note actions. An explicit 'Link transcript' control opens a bounded review sheet: heading 'Choose a transcript', search field, candidate title 'Research review discussion', Oct 2 · 10:03, small actual evidence 'Similar title · Same day'. One candidate 'Research follow-up' says 'Linked to another meeting' without exposing the other meeting's identity. Bottom actions Cancel / Link selected recording. Never show inferred confidence percentages. Small explanatory copy 'Review the recording before linking. Your choice is retained.' Phone mockup shows event detail full screen with back to Calendar, attendee links, two recording rows and a clearly separate unsaved note draft; no compressed calendar grid. Include small honest failure-state inset: 'Link not confirmed. Retry the same decision.' and Retry button, with text draft retained. Include 'Concept · fictional data' footer. Design must not imply a linked record was deleted or all ambiguous candidates were auto-linked. This is an explicit review of existing transcript candidates and durable manual decisions.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Prism roadmap board 23, sharing and collaborative governance. Very high fidelity FLAT professional application UI, large desktop plus narrow phone sheet and one compact error inset. No laptop or phone hardware. White warm-gray Notion-like surfaces, charcoal sans-serif, fine rules, restrained blue accents, generous whitespace. Product Prism. Desktop has a writing page titled 'Research handbook' behind an accessible Share dialog. Dialog heading 'Share Research handbook'. Clearly distinct sections: People / Link access / Publish. People selected, invite email field with placeholder name@example.test, familiar access dropdown 'Can view', 'Can comment', 'Suggest edits', 'Can edit', Invite button. Existing people rows Alex Rivera · Owner, Morgan Lee · Can edit, Sam Chen · Suggest edits, with small initial avatars and each role dropdown. A retained invitation card: 'Invitation created', a selectable example.test invitation URL, Copy link; demonstrate clipboard denied with 'Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.' NO false Copied label. Separate unobtrusive info callout: 'Suggest-only protection depends on the active server policy. Check workspace access settings.' This is not a claim enforcement is enabled. Beside sharing dialog a smaller governance panel 'Change proposals' with a pending proposal 'Update the introduction', clear human attribution 'Sam Chen', Before / Proposed text comparison and 'Review change' action. No auto-accept. Phone uses one full-width share sheet with the same role labels, recipient and retained invite card, large touch buttons and Back to document. Error inset: 'Access granted. Management role could not be updated.' with 'Retry role update', demonstrating partial success instead of rollback fiction. Scope labels distinguish 'This document' from 'Active vault access'; publishing remains a separate explicit action. Footer 'Concept · fictional collaborators'. Preserve precise permission distinctions; do not suggest guests own workspace roles or that a disabled server capability is enforced. Raster logo is illustrative only.
